   103→class _Transform:
   104→    def __init__(self) -> None:
   105→        self._collections: MutableMapping[str, str] = {}
   106→
   107→    def transform(self, cfn: Any) -> TransformResult:
   108→        """Transform the template"""
   109→        return [], self._walk(cfn.template, {}, cfn)
   110→
   111→    # pylint: disable=too-many-return-statements
   112→    def _walk(self, item: Any, params: MutableMapping[str, Any], cfn: Any):
   113→        obj = deepcopy(item)
   114→        if isinstance(obj, dict):
   115→            # adjust keys if needed
   116→            if params:
   117→                for k, v in item.items():
   118→                    _, new_k = self._replace_string_params(k, params)
   119→                    if new_k != k:
   120→                        del obj[k]
   121→                        obj[new_k] = v
   122→
   123→            for k, v in deepcopy(obj).items():
   124→                # see if key matches Fn::ForEach
   125→                if re.match(FUNCTION_FOR_EACH, k):
   126→                    # only translate the foreach if its valid
   127→                    foreach = _ForEach(k, v, self._collections)
   128→                    # get the values will flatten the foreach
   129→                    for collection_value in foreach.items(cfn):
   130→                        flattened = self._walk(
   131→                            v[2], {**params, **{v[0]: collection_value}}, cfn
   132→                        )
   133→                        for f_k, f_v in flattened.items():
   134→                            if f_k not in obj:
   135→                                obj[f_k] = f_v
   136→                            else:
   137→                                raise _ValueError(
   138→                                    f"Duplicate {f_k} while doing transformation",
   139→                                    f_k,
   140→                                )
   141→                    del obj[k]
   142→                elif k == "Fn::ToJsonString":
   143→                    # extra special handing for this as {} could be a valid value
   144→                    return obj
   145→                elif k == "Fn::Sub":
   146→                    if isinstance(v, str):
   147→                        only_string, obj[k] = self._replace_string_params(v, params)
   148→                        if only_string:
   149→                            return obj[k]
   150→                    if isinstance(v, list):
   151→                        only_string, obj[k][0] = self._replace_string_params(
   152→                            v[0],
   153→                            params,
   154→                        )
   155→                        if only_string:
   156→                            return obj[k][0]
   157→                        if len(v) == 2:
   158→                            obj[k][1] = self._walk(v[1], params, cfn)
   159→                elif k == "Fn::FindInMap":
   160→                    try:
   161→                        mapping = _ForEachValueFnFindInMap(get_hash(v), v)
   162→                        map_value = mapping.value(cfn, params, True, False)
   163→                        # if we can resolve it we will return it
   164→                        if isinstance(map_value, tuple([list]) + _SCALAR_TYPES):
   165→                            return map_value
   166→                    except Exception as e:  # pylint: disable=broad-exception-caught
   167→                        # We couldn't resolve the FindInMap so we are going to
   168→                        # leave it as it is
   169→                        LOGGER.debug("Transform and Fn::FindInMap error: %s", {str(e)})
   170→                    for i, el in enumerate(v):
   171→                        v[i] = self._walk(el, params, cfn)
   172→                    obj[k] = v
   173→                elif k == "Ref":
   174→                    if isinstance(v, str):
   175→                        if v in params:
   176→                            return params[v]
   177→                    elif isinstance(v, dict):
   178→                        r = self._walk(v, params, cfn)
   179→                        if isinstance(r, str):
   180→                            if r in params:
   181→                                return params[r]
   182→                        obj[k] = r
   183→                else:
   184→                    sub_value = self._walk(v, params, cfn)
   185→                    # a sub object may be none or we have returned
   186→                    # an empty object.  We don't want to remove empty
   187→                    # strings "" or 0 (zeros)
   188→                    # Remove `or sub_value == {}` for issue #2896
   189→                    if sub_value is None:
   190→                        del obj[k]
   191→                    else:
   192→                        obj[k] = sub_value
   193→        elif isinstance(obj, list):
   194→            for i, v in enumerate(obj):
   195→                obj[i] = self._walk(v, params, cfn)
   196→        return obj

   198→    def _replace_string_params(
   199→        self,
   200→        s: str,
   201→        params: Mapping[str, Any],
   202→    ) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
   203→        pattern = r"(\$|&){[a-zA-Z0-9\.:]+}"
   204→        if not re.search(pattern, s):
   205→            return (True, s)
   206→
   207→        new_s = deepcopy(s)
   208→        for k, v in params.items():
   209→            if isinstance(v, dict):
   210→                if sys.version_info.major == 3 and sys.version_info.minor > 8:
   211→                    v = (
   212→                        hashlib.md5(
   213→                            json.dumps(v).encode("utf-8"), usedforsecurity=False
   214→                        )
   215→                        .digest()
   216→                        .hex()[0:4]
   217→                    )
   218→                else:
   219→                    v = hashlib.md5(json.dumps(v).encode("utf-8")).digest().hex()[0:4]
   220→            new_s = re.sub(rf"\$\{{{k}\}}", v, new_s)
   221→            new_s = re.sub(rf"\&\{{{k}\}}", re.sub("[^0-9a-zA-Z]+", "", v), new_s)
   222→
   223→        if isinstance(s, str_node):
   224→            new_s = str_node(new_s, s.start_mark, s.end_mark)
   225→
   226→        return (not (bool(re.search(pattern, new_s))), new_s)

   229→class _ForEachValue:
   230→    def __init__(self, _hash: str, value: Any = None) -> None:
   231→        if value:
   232→            self._value = value
   233→
   234→        self._hash = _hash
   235→
   236→    @staticmethod
   237→    def create(obj: Any) -> _ForEachValue:
   238→        _hash = get_hash(obj)
   239→        if isinstance(obj, _SCALAR_TYPES):
   240→            return _ForEachValue(_hash, obj)
   241→        if isinstance(obj, dict):
   242→            if len(obj) != 1:
   243→                raise _ValueError("Object must have only one key", obj)
   244→
   245→            for k, v in obj.items():
   246→                if k == "Ref":
   247→                    return _ForEachValueRef(_hash, v)
   248→                if k == "Fn::FindInMap":
   249→                    return _ForEachValueFnFindInMap(_hash, v)
   250→
   251→        raise _TypeError(f"Unsupported value {obj!r}", obj)

   253→    # pylint: disable=unused-argument
   254→    def value(
   255→        self, cfn, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, only_params: bool = False
   256→    ):
   257→        return self._value
   258→
   259→    @property
   260→    def hash(self):
   261→        return self._hash

   275→            )

   281→                )

   298→class _ForEachValueFnFindInMap(_ForEachValue):
   299→    def __init__(self, _hash: str, obj: Any) -> None:
   300→        super().__init__(_hash)
   301→        if not isinstance(obj, list):
   302→            raise _TypeError("Fn::FindInMap should be a list", obj)
   303→
   304→        if len(obj) not in [3, 4]:
   305→            raise _ValueError("Fn::FindInMap requires a list of 3 or 4 values", obj)
   306→
   307→        self._map = [
   308→            _ForEachValue.create(obj[0]),
   309→            _ForEachValue.create(obj[1]),
   310→            _ForEachValue.create(obj[2]),
   311→        ]
   312→        if len(obj) == 4:
   313→            self._map.append(_FnFindInMapDefaultValue(get_hash(obj[3]), obj[3]))
   314→
   315→        self._obj = obj

   317→    def value(
   318→        self,
   319→        cfn: Any,
   320→        params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
   321→        only_params: bool = False,
   322→        default_on_resolver_failure: bool = True,
   323→    ) -> Any:
   324→        if params is None:
   325→            params = {}
   326→        t_map = deepcopy(self._map)
   327→        mapping = None
   328→        try:
   329→            mapping = cfn.template.get("Mappings", {}).get(
   330→                t_map[0].value(cfn, params, only_params)
   331→            )
   332→        except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-exception-caught
   333→            if len(cfn.template.get("Mappings", {}).keys()) == 1:
   334→                mapping = cfn.template.get("Mappings", {}).get(
   335→                    list(cfn.template.get("Mappings", {}).keys())[0]
   336→                )
   337→
   338→        try:
   339→            if mapping is None and isinstance(
   340→                t_map[1].value(cfn, params, only_params), str
   341→            ):
   342→                for k, v in cfn.template.get("Mappings", {}).items():
   343→                    if isinstance(v, dict):
   344→                        if t_map[1].value(cfn, params) in v:
   345→                            t_map[0] = _ForEachValue.create(k)
   346→                            mapping = v
   347→                            break
   348→        except _ResolveError:
   349→            pass
   350→
   351→        try:
   352→            if mapping is None and isinstance(
   353→                t_map[2].value(cfn, params, only_params), str
   354→            ):
   355→                for m1, mv1 in cfn.template.get("Mappings", {}).items():
   356→                    if isinstance(mv1, dict):
   357→                        for k1, kv1 in mv1.items():
   358→                            if isinstance(kv1, dict):
   359→                                if t_map[2].value(cfn, params, only_params) in kv1:
   360→                                    t_map[1] = _ForEachValue.create(k1)
   361→                                    t_map[0] = _ForEachValue.create(m1)
   362→                                    mapping = mv1
   363→                                    break
   364→        except _ResolveError:
   365→            pass
   366→
   367→        if mapping:
   368→            try:
   369→                t_map[1].value(cfn, params, only_params)
   370→            except _ResolveError:
   371→                try:
   372→                    t_map[2].value(cfn, params)
   373→                    max_length = -1
   374→                    for k, v in mapping.items():
   375→                        if isinstance(v, dict):
   376→                            if t_map[2].value(cfn, params, only_params) in v:
   377→                                if (
   378→                                    len(v[t_map[2].value(cfn, params, only_params)])
   379→                                    <= max_length
   380→                                ):
   381→                                    continue
   382→                                if isinstance(t_map[1], _ForEachValueRef):
   383→                                    if t_map[1]._ref._value == "AWS::AccountId":
   384→                                        global _ACCOUNT_ID
   385→                                        _ACCOUNT_ID = k
   386→                                t_map[1] = _ForEachValue.create(k)
   387→                                max_length = len(
   388→                                    v[t_map[2].value(cfn, params, only_params)]
   389→                                )
   390→                except _ResolveError:
   391→                    pass
   392→
   393→        if mapping:
   394→            try:
   395→                return mapping.get(t_map[1].value(cfn, params, only_params), {}).get(
   396→                    t_map[2].value(cfn, params, only_params)
   397→                )
   398→            except _ResolveError as e:
   399→                if len(self._map) == 4 and default_on_resolver_failure:
   400→                    return self._map[3].value(cfn, params, only_params)
   401→                # no default value and map 1 exists
   402→                try:
   403→                    for _, v in mapping.get(
   404→                        t_map[1].value(cfn, params, only_params), {}
   405→                    ).items():
   406→                        if isinstance(v, list):
   407→                            return v
   408→                except _ResolveError:
   409→                    pass
   410→                raise _ResolveError("Can't resolve Fn::FindInMap", self._obj) from e
   411→
   412→        if len(self._map) == 4 and default_on_resolver_failure:

   509→class _ForEachCollection:
   510→    def __init__(self, obj: Any) -> None:
   511→        self._collection: list[_ForEachValue] | None = None
   512→        self._obj = obj
   513→        self._fn: _ForEachValue | None = None
   514→        if isinstance(obj, list):
   515→            self._collection = []
   516→            self._string = obj
   517→            for item in obj:
   518→                self._collection.append(_ForEachValue.create(item))
   519→            return
   520→        if isinstance(obj, dict):
   521→            self._fn = _ForEachValue.create(obj)
   522→            return
   523→        raise _TypeError("Collection must be a list or an object", obj)
   524→
   525→    def values(
   526→        self, cfn: Any, collection_cache: MutableMapping[str, Any]
   527→    ) -> Iterator[str | dict[Any, Any]]:
   528→        if self._collection:
   529→            for item in self._collection:
   530→                try:
   531→                    yield item.value(cfn, {}, False)
   532→                except _ResolveError:
   533→                    v = "".join(random.choices(string.ascii_letters, k=_N))  # nosec
   534→                    collection_cache[item.hash] = v
   535→                    yield v
   536→            return
   537→        if self._fn:
   538→            try:
   539→                values = self._fn.value(cfn, {}, False)
   540→                if values is not None:
   541→                    if isinstance(values, list):
   542→                        for value in values:
   543→                            if isinstance(value, (str, dict)):
   544→                                yield value
   545→                            else:
   546→                                raise _ValueError(
   547→                                    (
   548→                                        "Fn::ForEach collection value "
   549→                                        f"must be a {_SCALAR_TYPES!r}"
   550→                                    ),
   551→                                    self._obj,
   552→                                )
   553→                        return
   554→                    raise _ValueError(
   555→                        "Fn::ForEach collection must return a list", self._obj
   556→                    )
   557→            except _ResolveError:
   558→                if self._fn.hash in collection_cache:
   559→                    yield from iter(collection_cache[self._fn.hash])
   560→                else:
   561→                    collection_cache[self._fn.hash] = []
   562→                    for _ in range(0, 2):
   563→                        v = "".join(random.choices(string.ascii_letters, k=_N))  # nosec
   564→                        collection_cache[self._fn.hash].append(v)
   565→                        yield v
   566→                return
   567→        raise _ResolveError("Fn::ForEach could not be resolved", self._obj)
